status: source regression candidate; Android device verification required
changes: Direct spoken repetitions use a session-specific completion certificate.
A target transition cannot commit before its matching voice succeeds.
Abort/Stop invalidates pending repetition and transaction without affecting newer sessions.
Failed voice rolls back only its own exact counter delta and usage statistics; conflicting user edits are preserved.
Pause/resume retains in-flight ownership and a late result cannot resurrect an obsolete start.
limitations: Headless Chromium smoke is not a physical Android playback test.
Real lock-screen playback, incoming call interruption, Bluetooth/headset controls, and long-running 28/99 journeys require device verification.
In a conflicting manual counter edit, the system preserves the newer value rather than blindly subtracting; diagnostics records the conflict for review.
